## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.11

v1.2.11 introduces the Large Number System and extends exact-value support for the player-facing values covered by this release. It also includes the managed-mob lifecycle fixes accepted during final runtime validation.

### Added
- Added three client-selectable large-number display modes: `SIMPLIFIED` (Упрощенный), `FULL` (Полный), and `ENGINEERING` (Инженерный).
- Added the `O` settings screen for switching large-number presentation at runtime.
- Added Simplified and Full letter suffix tables through `E3000`.
- Added `Ce` as the `E303` suffix in both letter modes.
- Added compact Full/Simplified high-order suffix generation with one leading capital and lowercase remaining letters.
- Added engineering notation with exponents in multiples of three.
- Added arbitrary-precision managed-mob HP and reward values backed by `BigDecimal` while preserving Minecraft's native health cap separately.
- Added arbitrary-precision player resource transport/storage for the migrated resource values.
- Added large-number unit selectors for managed-mob HP and reward input in the admin panel.
- Added regression coverage for large-number formatting, high-order suffix uniqueness/casing, exact unit parsing, and virtual managed-mob health.

### Changed
- Large-number display uses at most two decimal places with `HALF_UP` rounding and removes trailing zeros.
- Boundary rounding promotes values to the next unit where appropriate, for example `999999 -> 1M`.
- HUD currency/resource values, managed-mob HP/rewards, rune stat output, and other migrated displays now use the shared formatter.
- Simplified mode keeps short readable suffixes throughout the letter range, including high-order forms such as `Vgc` and `Nvnnc`.
- Full mode uses more descriptive but bounded suffixes such as `Vigce`, `Unvigce`, `Duce`, `Quing`, and `Novnong`.
- Legacy letter suffixes remain accepted as input where they are unambiguous.
- Exact stored/calculated values remain separate from the shortened presentation.

### Fixed
- Fixed managed mobs disappearing across startup, reconnect, and chunk unload/load cycles.
- Managed mobs now follow chunk lifecycle instead of relying on reconnect-time `EntityTracker` mutation.
- Removed false `Managed mob lost from world registry` churn caused by normal spawn-chunk unloading.
- Removed repeated managed-mob chunk-save/respawn INFO spam while retaining warnings for genuine entity loss.
- Managed mobs no longer persist stale session entities into chunk NBT, preventing duplicate/stale instances after reload.

### Other
- Runtime validation covered initial managed-mob spawn, repeated relog, kill/respawn, full server restart, and chunk lifecycle behavior.
- Runtime validation covered Simplified, Full, and Engineering number modes in the HUD and managed-mob displays, including `E303` and `E3000` control values.
- Release metadata is aligned to `1.2.11`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.11.jar` on clients that need the custom GUI/HUD/rune features and on the server. Clients that do not need those client-side features may connect without `customguimod`.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.10...v1.2.11](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.10...v1.2.11)
